feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 June 2026 7:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Biscay, with a shallow area of low pressure west of Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this morning, but remaining southwest 3 or 4 in the southeast of the area. Occasionally reaching force 7 in the west this afternoon, then decreasing south or southwest 4 or 5 in all waters tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, occasionally rough in the west this afternoon and evening.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches, becoming fair this morning. Then outbreaks of rain spreading from the west this evening.


##Visibility##

Poor or very poor in mist and fog patches, soon becoming good. Then occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
